description: Harness-neutral discovery catalog for Time Series Analytics workflow skills. Paths are relative to the microservice root.

skills.name: time-series-analytics-user
skills.description: Build a new time-series analytics use case on top of the deployed microservice: author a UDF + TICKscript (threshold alert, rate-of-change, rolling z-score, or pretrained-model inference), package it, deploy it over REST, feed it data, and wire up MQTT/OPC UA alerting. Not for modifying the service's own source (use time-series-analytics-dev).

skills.name: time-series-analytics-dev
skills.description: Develop the Time Series Analytics microservice itself: build/deploy via Docker Compose or Helm, run the unit and functional test suites, modify src/main.py, src/classifier_startup.py, or src/opcua_alerts.py, and follow release/versioning conventions. Not for merely deploying the prebuilt image to build a use case (use time-series-analytics-user).
triggers: run the time series analytics tests
add an endpoint to time series analytics
debug time series analytics service code
build time series analytics from source
cut a release for time series analytics
